about_the_game:
Sword of Shadow: Revolution is a hardcore survival and building simulator set in a grim post-apocalypse, where every day is a struggle for a sip of water and a nail to build a wall. You don't just give orders from a safe bunker. You are your base's most vital resource. Your hands chop the trees, your weapon clears the path, and your will is the only thing preventing the world from plunging into total darkness.

Your Life is the Main Resource:

  • Personal Survival: Monitor your thirst, hunger, and fatigue levels. Drink, eat, sleep – otherwise, your next foray will be your last.

  • Exploring the Ruins: Leave the walls of your base and personally navigate the dangerous ruins of the old world. Need fuel for the generator? Canned food for the pantry? Medicine for the wounded? It all lies in the darkest corners where no human has set foot.

  • Crafting and Building: A found pipe isn't just a "unit of metal." A log isn't just wood for a shelter. Gather, dismantle, and create everything with your own hands: from a simple axe to a complex water storage system.

From Shelter to Fortress:
Your base isn't an abstract point on the map. It's your home, which you build from the first stone in the foundation. You erect every wall, every trap, every watchtower yourself, so that one night it can withstand the horde of creatures. There are no peaceful farms here – only a fortified perimeter behind which you can allow yourself an hour of sleep.

Resources or Death:
Food doesn't appear out of thin air. Water is a precious commodity. Gasoline is the lifeblood of your vehicle and generator. Resource gathering is hellish labor. The most valuable finds are in places others dare not go. You will pay for them with your own blood and sweat.

Dangerous Raids:
For advanced technology, weapons, and medicine, you must go to the most godforsaken places: flooded subways, infected laboratories, marauder camps. This isn't an abstract mission – it's your personal descent into hell. Every such raid is a gamble with your life. Will you return with loot? Or will you become just another warning to others?

Welcome to your personal hell. Lead the Survival Revolution.

  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F / AMD Ryzen 7 5700X
  • Memory: 32 GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
